body.name: Determinant--factorization residual
body.construction: For the group permutation minimizing \(D_H\), let \(T=T_{\theta,\widetilde\theta}\), \(R_i=r_{\theta i}\circ\beta_{\theta i}^{-1}\), and \(S_i=r_{\widetilde\theta,\pi(i)}\circ\beta_{\widetilde\theta,\pi(i)}^{-1}\). Then \(\mathcal E(\theta,\widetilde\theta)=\lVert|\det DT|-1\rVert_{L^2(\lambda^n)}+\{\sum_{i\in[n]}\lVert R_i\circ T_i-S_i\rVert_{L^2(\lambda^n)}^2\}^{1/2}\).
